blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Monday defended its handling of a protest near Malacañang, saying its officers followed established protocols amid reports of a physical confrontation with teachers and students a day before World Teachers’ Day. “While reports have surfaced regarding the incident, we likewise recognize the presumption of regularity in the performance of official duties, pending the submission of official reports from the ground,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said in a statement.
